integrity: All n>=2 are handled by a symbolic parity/digit-sum proof. The companion integer-only checks verify direct GCDs for 2<=n<=200 and independently minimize valuations and construct witnesses for 2<=n<=1000; these finite checks are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The formula gives only the 2-adic component of the entire selected binomial GCD at step three. It does not determine odd factors or apply to other steps.
title: Binary-weight trichotomy for the ternary-step binomial GCD
